PPC Romania
 👥 : Digital Solutions
 📍 : Bucharest

 #WePowerYourTalent
 The energy transition happens through people who see their role beyond tasks and understand that what they do has a real impact.
At PPC, we contribute every day to a safer and cleaner energy system, from the networks that connect communities, to renewable energy that transforms the energy mix, or solutions that make electric mobility accessible.
Regardless of the role, our contribution is reflected every day in the communities we serve, in the customers who choose us, and in an energy system that is constantly evolving. We are present across the entire energy value chain and we are looking for motivated people to join us.
If you are curious to understand things in depth, responsible for seeing them through to completion, and open to working in a continuously changing environment, then your place is with us.
 Together with us, you have the chance to grow every day, contributing to the energy transition, being responsible for:
Basic network configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting to ensure optimal performance and security 
Document network configurations and update troubleshooting procedures 
Ensures continuity of Telecommunication services and collaborates with internal and external teams
Analyzes any type of traffic and implements new functionalities required by the Business, including validation and acceptance of solutions 
Works with all Digital Solutions departments, including system engineers, level 1 support staff to resolve issues
Ensures quality of services during changes in Network & Telecommunication solutions
Responsible for service continuity, monitoring and incident response in the Network & Telecommunications area 
 What You’ll Need To Succeed
Minimum 1 year of work experience on network and telecommunication area 
Experience with software for capturing and analyzing network traffic
Experience with monitoring systems
Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Telecommunications, Automation, Computer Science or equivalent (or pursuing a bachelor degree, terminal year) 
Manages various computer network infrastructures, including basic implementation and service provisioning, experience with routers, switches, wi-fi, VPN 
Monitors performance and ensures system availability including reliability of all components in the solution
Cisco certifications (CCNA) or similar 
English - advanced level 
 Nice To Have Experience With
Understanding of cloud networking concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 
 Knowledge of automation and scripting for network management (e.g., Python, Bash) 
 But Also
Ability to achieve goals by working independently.
Crisis management skills, planning, prioritizing and organizing skills
Collaborates with other colleagues to support team spirit and the appropriate work atmosphere
Ability to work on several activities in parallel
 What We Offer You
 🚀 A place where you grow, not just work
Clear professional and personal development paths 
Access to courses, mentoring, and coaching programs 
Role-relevant certifications 
Real internal mobility opportunities within the PPC Romania Group 
 💛 A fair package that reflects your contribution
Fixed annual bonus (equivalent of one salary) + performance bonus 
Meal vouchers worth 45 RON/day and bonuses (Energy Day, Easter, Christmas, etc.) 
Partial reimbursement of vacation costs (2,400 RON – PPC Contract) 
Additional vacation days + extra days off (birthday, Energy Day) 
Pillar III pension contribution worth 100 RON 
Bonus for employee referrals – ranging between 1,800 RON – 7,200 RON gross depending on the role 
Reimbursement for vision devices up to 700 RON, once every 2 years 
Voucher for partial compensation of energy consumption 
 🏥 Real support for your well-being
Medical subscription / private insurance 
Access to Bookster 
Partner offers 
 🖥️ Flexibility that respects your rhythm
Hybrid schedule (office & smart working) 
Short Friday 
 What Else You Should Know
 Recruitment process confidentiality
 At PPC, we respect the confidentiality of every application. Only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview, and all other applications will be stored in our database for a maximum of one year.
 About PPC
 We are leaders in energy in South-East Europe, active in electricity production, distribution, and supply, as well as in developing innovative solutions for a sustainable future. With an installed capacity of 12.4 GW, we supply energy to 8.7 million customers and deliver over 35 TWh annually.
In Romania, PPC became a top player following the acquisition of Enel companies in October 2023. With a history starting in 1950, we are listed on the Athens Stock Exchange and continuously expand our vision.
 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
 We believe energy comes from people. At PPC, every voice matters, and diversity is the engine of our innovation. Regardless of age, ethnicity, gender, or disability, we offer an inclusive environment where you can grow and perform.
🔹 # EnergyForEveryone – for your career, for the future, for all.
